clauses.quote: Unless otherwise set forth, Extra Service Assignments shall be remunerated based on the product of the assigned factor times Class II, Step 5 of the regular salary schedule.
All remuneration which is based on a percentage of a salary schedule step will be rounded off to the nearest dollar, except for the Hourly Rate Factors of 7.7.8.
clauses.subject_text: All remuneration which is based on a percentage of a salary schedule step
clauses.notes: Administrative rounding rule; functionally an obligation on management to apply the rounding formula.

clauses.quote: All remuneration for extra-service assignments shall be paid twice a year if a full-time assignment or at the end of the activity if less than a full year except for department chairpersons, bilingual stipends, and athletic directors, who shall be paid monthly as a part of their contract salary.
clauses.notes: Specifies payment schedule; the relative clause extending to directors/chairpersons constitutes a separate duty but is grammatically tied to the same sentence.
